h1: Pre-Engineered Buildings in Pakistan: Designed, Fabricated and Erected by One Team
quickAnswer: A pre-engineered building (PEB) is a steel building whose parts are designed in advance and made in a factory. Steel Mind Engineers designs, fabricates and erects PEBs in Pakistan under one contract.
alt: Aerial view of a pre-engineered steel building built by Steel Mind Engineers in Pakistan.

faq.q: What is the difference between a PEB and a normal steel building?
faq.a: A PEB is designed as a complete system. Each frame is sized for the exact loads of your building, so the steel is used where it is needed and not where it is not.

faq.q: How big can a PEB be?
faq.a: Clear-span frames can cover wide spans without inner columns. Steel Mind Engineers has built a PEB shed of 97,888 square feet.

faq.q: Can a PEB be extended later?
faq.a: Yes. A PEB is bolted together, so bays can be added at the end of the building.

blocks.title: What Steel Mind Engineers Offers in PEB

blocks.text: A pre-engineered building, or PEB, is a steel building whose parts are designed in advance and made in a factory. Steel Mind Engineers handles the design, the fabrication and the erection. You get one contract for the whole building, and one team answers your questions from the first sketch to the last bolt.

Each page in this section explains one part of a PEB project. You can read them in order or go straight to the topic you need. PEB Overview explains what a PEB is and where it is used. Advantages compares speed, cost, span and flexibility. 3D Concept shows how you see the building before it is made. One-Step Solution explains the single-contract process. Engineering Department describes how the design is done. Primary Framing System covers columns and rafters. Basic Parameters lists the data needed to start a design. Sub Structures covers purlins, girts, bracing and add-on structures such as canopies. Crane System explains buildings with overhead cranes. Mezzanine System explains extra floors inside the building. Accessories covers skylights, ventilators, doors and insulation.

Steel Mind Engineers built a 96,600 square foot PEB crane shed for Haier at Raiwind, a 97,888 square foot crane and mezzanine shed for Haier, and a 39,330 square foot PEB dairy shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. See every project on the Our Projects page.
